signal: White Cup continues expanding its distributor-focused CRM plus BI platform, natively integrated with ERP, after 20+ years serving distribution and manufacturing

email.subject1: pipeline White Cup leaves on the table
email.body1:
Brad, White Cup has built a distributor-focused CRM and BI platform with deep ERP integration over 20 plus years.

In a niche like distribution, there are usually more in-market accounts than the team can touch, and reps burn time on research and CRM work instead of meetings. Our AI SDR handles research, writing, and follow-up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for White Cup off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Brad, quick follow-up for White Cup.

In a defined market like distribution software, most teams cannot say how many meetings they need to book to hit the number, so the gap shows up late and recovering the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings White Cup needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Brad, last bit of proof for White Cup.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how White Cup's reply rate likely compares to other B2B software teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Brad, I will stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters, and I know a distribution-focused motion keeps you busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a distribution-software motion? I will tailor it to White Cup either way.
